sloka: एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी राघवेण महात्मना ।उवाचेदं सुनिर्लज्जा धृष्टमात्महितं वचः ॥२-१८-१९॥
transliteration: evamuktā tu kaikeyī rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।uvācedaṁ sunirlajjā dhṛṣṭamātmahitaṁ vacaḥ ॥2-18-19॥

translations.english: When Kaikeyi was thus asked by the magnanimous scion of the Raghus (Rama) she uttered unashamed these impudent words in her own interest.
